line.name: Kristoff Guardrail
line.description: CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL ASSUMPTION: Mac filename 'Kri-Guard-Rob' was assumed to be 'Guardian of the Farm' - that name belongs to a different, unrelated brand entirely. The real product is 'Kristoff Guardrail,' debuted 2022, ranked #8 on Cigar Coop's 2023 Cigar of the Year countdown.
